Name: DPDP Act 2023 - Digital Personal Data Protection Act
Description: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) establishes India's framework for personal data protection, prescribing obligations for Data Fiduciaries regarding consent, security safeguards, breach reporting, retention, and data principal rights.

Requirements.Name: Provide clear, standalone privacy notice prior to processing.
Requirements.Description: Is a standalone, clear privacy notice provided before collection?

Requirements.Name: Specify categories of personal data collected.
Requirements.Description: Does the notice list all categories of personal data collected?

Requirements.Name: Specify purpose(s) of processing.
Requirements.Description: Does the notice clearly state each processing purpose?

Requirements.Name: Explain consent withdrawal process with equivalent ease.
Requirements.Description: Can Data Principals withdraw consent with the same/easier steps than giving it?

Requirements.Name: Explain rights exercise process and complaint channels.
Requirements.Description: Does the notice provide rights workflow and complaint contact (Board + internal)?

Requirements.Name: Provide language options (English + Eighth Schedule languages).
Requirements.Description: Is the notice available in English + relevant Indian languages?

Requirements.Name: Provide contact of DPO/authorised person.
Requirements.Description: Does the notice publish DPO/contact email and address?

Requirements.Name: Notify Board & affected Data Principals of personal data breach.
Requirements.Description: Is there a breach notification SOP with timelines & templates?

Requirements.Name: Maintain a breach log and corrective action records.
Requirements.Description: Are all incidents logged with root cause and remediation?

Requirements.Name: Execute urgent remedial/mitigation measures when directed.
Requirements.Description: Can urgent mitigations be executed and evidenced?

Requirements.Name: Specified purpose provided voluntarily by Data Principal (opt-out possible).
Requirements.Description: Is voluntary-provided data processed only for the specified purpose unless DP opts-out?

Requirements.Name: State benefits/services where consent previously given / from notified databases.
Requirements.Description: Are government benefits processed per policy/law with records?

Requirements.Name: State functions, sovereignty/security.
Requirements.Description: Is processing limited to the lawful function with minimization?

Requirements.Name: Legal obligations to disclose to State.
Requirements.Description: Is disclosure documented and limited to legal scope?

Requirements.Name: Compliance with judgments/orders (including foreign civil claims).
Requirements.Description: Are court/legal orders tracked and fulfilled accurately?

Requirements.Name: Medical emergency (life/health threat).
Requirements.Description: Is emergency processing SOP defined and logged?

Requirements.Name: Epidemics/public health threat measures.
Requirements.Description: Are public health processing controls documented?

Requirements.Name: Disaster/breakdown of public order.
Requirements.Description: Are disaster-response processing logs maintained?

Requirements.Name: Employment-related purposes and safeguarding employer from loss/liability.
Requirements.Description: Is employee processing documented with confidentiality controls?

Requirements.Name: Data Fiduciary responsible for compliance incl. processors.
Requirements.Description: Is accountability documented (RACI) for DF and processors?

Requirements.Name: Use Data Processor only under valid contract.
Requirements.Description: Do all processors have signed DPAs before processing?

Requirements.Name: Ensure data accuracy when used for decisions/disclosure.
Requirements.Description: Are data validation steps enforced?

Requirements.Name: Implement appropriate TOMs to ensure observance.
Requirements.Description: Is there an ISMS and periodic internal audit?

Requirements.Name: Protect personal data using reasonable security safeguards.
Requirements.Description: Are baseline security controls implemented (access control, encryption, backups)?

Requirements.Name: Intimate personal data breach to Board and affected DPs.
Requirements.Description: Have previous breaches been intimated within required form/manner?

Requirements.Name: Erase personal data when consent withdrawn or purpose served.
Requirements.Description: Do deletion workflows trigger upon withdrawal or purpose completion?

Requirements.Name: Cause processors to erase data supplied for processing.
Requirements.Description: Are processors instructed and verified for deletion?

Requirements.Name: Define inactivity period after which purpose deemed not served.
Requirements.Description: Is inactivity threshold configured as prescribed for your class?

Requirements.Name: Publish DPO/business contact info.
Requirements.Description: Is DPO/contact info published and accurate?

Requirements.Name: Establish effective grievance redressal mechanism.
Requirements.Description: Is a helpdesk/ticketing system available to Data Principals?

Requirements.Name: Clarifies DP not approaching during inactivity window.
Requirements.Description: Is inactivity handling aligned with rule explanation?

Requirements.Name: Obtain verifiable parental/guardian consent before processing child's data.
Requirements.Description: Is parental consent verified (KYC/token) before processing?

Requirements.Name: Avoid detrimental processing affecting a child's well-being.
Requirements.Description: Was a child-impact assessment performed?

Requirements.Name: No tracking/behavioural monitoring or targeted ads to children.
Requirements.Description: Are tracking/ad systems disabled for child users?

Requirements.Name: Exemptions/classes/purposes may be prescribed.
Requirements.Description: Are any exemptions applicable documented?

Requirements.Name: Govt may notify safe-processing age exemptions for specific DFs.
Requirements.Description: If notified, is exemption scope implemented and evidenced?

Requirements.Name: Govt may notify SDF based on factors (volume, sensitivity, risk, etc.).
Requirements.Description: Has SDF designation been assessed/notified?

Requirements.Name: DPO represents SDF under the Act.
Requirements.Description: Is a DPO formally appointed to represent the SDF?

Requirements.Name: DPO must be based in India.
Requirements.Description: Is the DPO physically based in India?

Requirements.Name: DPO responsible to Board/similar governing body.
Requirements.Description: Does the DPO report to Board/GC-level?

Requirements.Name: DPO is point of contact for grievance redressal.
Requirements.Description: Is DPO listed as grievance PoC?

Requirements.Name: Appoint independent Data Auditor for data audit.
Requirements.Description: Is an independent data auditor appointed and engaged annually?

Requirements.Name: Periodic DPIA describing rights, purpose, risk, mitigation.
Requirements.Description: Are DPIAs performed for high-risk processing at least annually?

Requirements.Name: Periodic audit.
Requirements.Description: Are periodic audits completed and tracked to closure?

Requirements.Name: Other prescribed measures.
Requirements.Description: Are any additional mandated measures implemented?

Requirements.Name: Provide summary of personal data processed and processing activities.
Requirements.Description: Can DPs obtain a summary of data & processing activities?

Requirements.Name: Disclose identities of all DFs/Processors with whom data shared.
Requirements.Description: Does the DSAR include list of recipients & data categories shared?

Requirements.Name: Provide other prescribed information related to DP's personal data.
Requirements.Description: Is all additional required info provided upon request?

Requirements.Name: Law-enforcement sharing carve-out.
Requirements.Description: Are LEA requests handled via controlled lawful process?

Requirements.Name: Right to correction, completion, updating, erasure (post-consent).
Requirements.Description: Is there a workflow to correct/complete/update/erase data?

Requirements.Name: Correct inaccurate or misleading personal data.
Requirements.Description: Are inaccuracies corrected within SLA?

Requirements.Name: Complete incomplete personal data.
Requirements.Description: Are incompletenesses completed within SLA?

Requirements.Name: Update personal data.
Requirements.Description: Are updates processed and recorded?

Requirements.Name: Erase personal data unless retention necessary by law.
Requirements.Description: Is erasure honored unless legal retention applies?

Requirements.Name: Provide readily available grievance redressal.
Requirements.Description: Is a grievance channel available online and monitored?

Requirements.Name: Respond to grievances within prescribed period.
Requirements.Description: Are grievances answered within the prescribed SLA?

Requirements.Name: Exhaust internal grievance before Board.
Requirements.Description: Do responses state escalation path and Board recourse?

Requirements.Name: Allow nomination for post-death/incapacity rights.
Requirements.Description: Can DPs nominate another individual and is it recorded?

Requirements.Name: Define incapacity (unsoundness/infirmity).
Requirements.Description: Is incapacity handling documented?

Requirements.Name: Data Principal duties (lawful exercise, no impersonation, no suppression, authentic info).
Requirements.Description: Does the DF's T&C/UX inform DPs of their duties under the Act?

Requirements.Name: Access Control
Requirements.Description: Are RBAC and least privilege enforced across systems?

Requirements.Name: Encryption in Transit
Requirements.Description: Is TLS enforced for all external/internal transfers?

Requirements.Name: Encryption at Rest
Requirements.Description: Is encryption at rest enabled for all data stores?

Requirements.Name: Backup & Recovery
Requirements.Description: Are backups encrypted, tested, and retained per policy?

Requirements.Name: Logging & Monitoring
Requirements.Description: Are security logs collected/retained and alerts monitored?

Requirements.Name: Vulnerability Management
Requirements.Description: Are periodic VA/PT scans performed and remediated?

Requirements.Name: Incident Response
Requirements.Description: Is IR playbook tested with tabletop exercises?

Requirements.Name: Third-Party Risk
Requirements.Description: Are vendors assessed and monitored for data protection?

Requirements.Name: Data Minimisation
Requirements.Description: Is only necessary data collected and retained?

Requirements.Name: Secure SDLC
Requirements.Description: Are privacy/security controls integrated in SDLC?

Requirements.Name: DSAR Identity Verification
Requirements.Description: Is identity verified before fulfilling DSARs?

Requirements.Name: DSAR SLA
Requirements.Description: Are DSARs fulfilled within prescribed SLA?

Requirements.Name: DSAR Redaction
Requirements.Description: Are third-party details redacted appropriately?

Requirements.Name: Portability Export
Requirements.Description: Is data export provided in structured, machine-readable form?

Requirements.Name: Erasure Propagation
Requirements.Description: Is erasure propagated to all processors/recipients?

Requirements.Name: Ticketing
Requirements.Description: Is a ticketing system available for grievances?

Requirements.Name: SLA
Requirements.Description: Are response/resolution SLAs met?

Requirements.Name: Escalation
Requirements.Description: Is there an escalation matrix up to DPO?

Requirements.Name: Communication
Requirements.Description: Are template responses clear and tracked?

Requirements.Name: Nomination UX
Requirements.Description: Is nomination available in account settings and verified?

Requirements.Name: Cross-border transfer permitted unless restricted by Central Government.
Requirements.Description: Are transfers to non-restricted territories documented with contractual and technical controls?

Requirements.Name: Data flow mapping for cross-border transfers.
Requirements.Description: Is there an auditable record of where personal data is stored, replicated, backed up, and accessed?

Requirements.Name: SDF additional transfer restrictions for Schedule 3 data.
Requirements.Description: If classified as SDF, are transfers of Schedule 3 categories restricted to approved regions?

Requirements.Name: Use only registered Consent Manager for consent management.
Requirements.Description: Is consent managed via a registered Consent Manager with valid registration from the Board?

Requirements.Name: Consent Manager interoperability and accountability.
Requirements.Description: Does the Consent Manager enable DP to give/withdraw/review consent and is it interoperable with DF systems?

Requirements.Name: Consent records with timestamps and purpose tags.
Requirements.Description: Are consent records stored with timestamp, purpose, version, and exportable for audit?

Requirements.Name: Enforce data residency within approved AWS regions.
Requirements.Description: Are SCPs or IAM policies enforcing that personal data resources are created only in ap-south-1/ap-south-2?

Requirements.Name: Prevent uncontrolled cross-region replication of personal data.
Requirements.Description: Are S3 replication rules, RDS read replicas, and backups restricted to India regions?

Requirements.Name: 48-hour pre-erasure intimation to Data Principal.
Requirements.Description: Is the Data Principal informed at least 48 hours before erasure, allowing them to log in or exercise rights?

Requirements.Name: Minimum 1-year (365-day) retention for logs and traffic data.
Requirements.Description: Are CloudTrail logs, VPC Flow Logs, and processing logs retained for at least 365 days for breach detection and investigation?

Requirements.Name: Sub-processor governance and transparency.
Requirements.Description: Is a sub-processor list maintained with advance change notifications and contractual flow-down of security and privacy obligations?

Requirements.Name: Sub-processor audit and compliance verification.
Requirements.Description: Are sub-processors periodically assessed for DPDPA compliance with documented evidence?
